# @arki/async

> Abortable `sleep`, lodash-compatible `debounce` and `throttle`, and structured concurrency on plain Promises and `AbortSignal`. It is not a mutex or a retry library.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/async`: Abortable sleep, debounce and throttle, and structured concurrency (scoped, all, mapConcurrent, race, timeout) on plain Promises and AbortSignal. `ASYNC_ERROR_CODES`, `AsyncError`, `Cancelled`, `Deadline`, `MAX_WAIT_MS`, `SUPERVISOR_FAILURES`, `ScopeFailed`, `all`, `child`, `cleanup`, `createLifetime`, `debounce`; and 32 more.
- `@arki/async/errors`: `ASYNC_ERROR_CODES`, `AsyncError`, `Cancelled`, `Deadline`, `MAX_WAIT_MS`, `SUPERVISOR_FAILURES`, `ScopeFailed`, `abortedError`, `assertWait`, `cleanupFailed`, `invalidConcurrency`, `invalidWait`; and 7 more.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite

- Cancellation is cooperative. Pass each task's `signal` on to `fetch` and `sleep`.
- `race` is `Promise.any`: the first task to fulfill wins.
- `timeout` rejects at the deadline, but a task that ignores its signal keeps running.
- Waits above `MAX_WAIT_MS` (about 24.8 days) reject with `ARKI_ASYNC_E001`.
- Use `MockClock` from `@arki/clock` in tests, not fake timers.
